title: feat(units): unitConfig on a number field, and the write path checks the unit code
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu

Part of #35489

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #35808

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:搭建应用的人可以给数量字段写明计量单位(整列一个标准单位,或每条记录自己带单位代码),保存记录时系统检查单位代码是不是标准单位或本组织仍在用的单位,不是就拒绝;本组织的单位只能停用,任何人、任何自动化都删不掉。
- 为什么做:计量单位第一版,替物料、库存、采购这类带数量的业务落地「字段声明单位」和「写入时检查单位」两件事。
- 出错会怎样:写错或已停用的单位代码,保存会被拒绝并指出是哪个字段;库里已有的旧值不动数量时照常可改其它字段;本次合并可以直接撤回,不涉及数据迁移。
- 要你做什么:无

ADR-0158 R1, the membership card: the `unitConfig` key (U4, settled under L3), the standalone unit-code marker (Open item 8, ruled A), the asynchronous write check (U5, Open item 9's settlement 7013996288), the engine-side refusal of a `sys_unit` delete (Requirement 1 of 7030061316), and the error codes (Open item 3). The ADR-0158 amendment text is handed to the seat; this PR touches no `docs/adr/**`.

## What changes

**`unitConfig` on a field** (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, `UnitConfigSchema`): a discriminated union on `unitMode`, three closed shapes.

- `{ unitMode: 'fixed', unit: 'KGM' }` on a `number`: one standard unit, checked at parse against `STANDARD_UNITS` (exact uppercase; `C62` and `EA` are answered with the piece, `H87`, U2).
- `{ unitMode: 'record', unitField: 'uom', unitDimension?: 'mass' }` on a `number`: each record names its unit by code in the sibling `text` field.
- `{ unitMode: 'code', unitDimension?: 'count' }` on a `text`: the Open item 8 marker, a field holding a unit code with no quantity beside it (a material's base unit). A unit marker, not a fourth value domain: `ValueDomainSchema` stays at three members (U1), and the marker is refused beside a `valueDomain`.
- Refused on every other type (`currency`, `formula`, `summary` included, U8: no reader yet). Bare `unit` / `uom` / `unitCode` / `dimension` keys on a field are refused with guidance naming `unitConfig`.

**The object door** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, `refuseDishonestRecordUnitField`, beside the currency one): a `record` pointer into nothing, into itself, into a non-`text` field, into a field carrying its own `unitConfig` (L3: the pointer is the declaration), into a `text` field that declares a `valueDomain` (one column, two vocabularies; added in 44bf630f1e for L2 S2), or through a parent (`PARENT.UNIT_FIELD` is reserved, L3), and two quantities sharing one unit field with different `unitDimension` values.

**N4**: `standardUnitOf(code)` (`packages/spec/src/data/standard-units.ts`) is the one own-property lookup on `STANDARD_UNITS`; the write check asks membership only through it, so `toString` or `__proto__` is never a member, and the `fixed` enum (built from the table's own keys) is pinned to admit exactly the codes it admits.

**The write check** (`packages/objectql/src/validation/unit-code-membership.ts`, new): at every insert, by-id update, predicate update and `validate()` preview, after the currency-code check. Open item 9, as settled:

- case 1: a code written must be a standard code or one of the organization's own non-retired `sys_unit` rows, in exact uppercase (never folded), of the declared `unitDimension` (point 5);
- case 2: a non-blank quantity written beside a resting code that is no longer a member is refused, and the message names the field, never the stored value;
- case 3: a quantity beside a blank code is refused;
- the row image is judged only when the write touches the quantity or its unit field (point 1, ADR-0113 D1); a standalone marker is judged as a unit field with no quantity (point 6); a write touching neither is never judged, so a row resting on free text stays editable in its other fields (point 7, until the backfill, #35492).

The organization's units are read once per organization per write (`sys_unit`, `organization_id` + `code $in`, a minimal system context that keeps only the caller's transaction and trace id), and never for a write whose codes are all standard.

**A unit is retired, never deleted** (Requirement 1): `refuseOrganizationUnitDelete` in `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, right after `assertWriteAllowed` and before any middleware or hook, so it holds for a user, a system writer and an automation run, by id and batched: 405 `ERR_UNIT_DELETE_REFUSED`. `organization_admin` names `sys_unit` explicitly (`allowRead/Create/Edit: true, allowDelete: false`, no `modifyAllRecords`), as `sys_audit_log` does; the effective permissions the client reads now offer no delete.

**Error codes** (Open item 3), registered in the ledger under `@objectstack/objectql`, one per remedy (the `ERR_HOME_CURRENCY_UNSET` precedent): `ERR_UNIT_CODE_REQUIRED`, `ERR_UNIT_CODE_UNKNOWN`, `ERR_UNIT_CODE_RETIRED`, `ERR_UNIT_DIMENSION_MISMATCH` (400 each), `ERR_UNIT_DELETE_REFUSED` (405, the data door's status for the same verb; the suffix follows `EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED`).

**Open item 6, first half**: a quantity needs no `scale`, and may keep one. The currency precedent (`field-currency-scale-refused.test.ts`, ruling 5805782503) is that a currency's decimal places are the currency's, not a field setting, and it never made a scale required. A unit's own decimal places are U6, which R1 does not ship (#35498 owns that setting), so R1 has nothing to require a scale for; a `number`'s optional `scale` stays what L4 names it, the ceiling. Pinned: `a number declaring unitConfig needs no scale (Open item 6, first half)`, with and without `scale: 3`.

**Where it diverges from `currencyConfig`, and why**

- `unitMode` is required with no default: an absent `currencyConfig` already means the tenant currency, and no tenant unit exists (L3).
- `unit`, not `defaultUnit`: under `fixed` it is the one unit, never a default (L3; `defaultCurrency` is the recorded misnomer).
- `unitDimension`, not `dimension`: the bare word is a group-by axis in the analytics schemas (L3).
- A discriminated union of closed shapes instead of one shape with a cross-key refinement: the discriminator is required, so each mode's keys are its variant's and the rule reaches the published JSON Schema (`oneOf`). `currencyConfig` cannot take this form because its discriminator has a default.
- The membership read is asynchronous and organization-scoped (`sys_unit`); the currency-code check is pure (ISO 4217).

**Ripple** (the new key's classification, no behaviour): metadata-core field-level security keeps `unitConfig`; driver-sql's DDL classes it `presentation`; the metadata form reconciliation omits it (the picker is #35490); the liveness ledger row; the federated injected-column census row for the `sys_unit` read; a `variant-docs.json` entry (`generated-reference-only`, the gap stated); the `sys_unit` docblock names its readers.

## Read first

1. `packages/objectql/src/validation/unit-code-membership.ts`, `assertUnitCodes`: the three Open item 9 cases and when the row image is judged.
2. `packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`, the two `touchesUnitCodes` hunks: the by-id image and the predicate path's prior rows.
3. `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, the `refuseOrganizationUnitDelete` line: before middleware, so no context bypasses it.

## Two-minute verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/default-permission-sets.unit-of-measure.integration.test.ts` (after building its closure): 23 tests pass, among them `the engine refuses to delete a unit in every context` for an administrator, an owner, a member, a system writer and an automation run, each by id and batched, 405 `ERR_UNIT_DELETE_REFUSED`, every unit still stored.

## Tests

New suites, each refusal case asserting the envelope (`code` and `status`), never a bare throw:

- `packages/spec/src/data/field-unit-config.test.ts` (62): `standardUnitOf` and N4 (`toString`, `constructor`, `__proto__` are no member); each mode's shape, aliases and off-mode keys; which type carries which mode; the marker beside a `valueDomain`; bare `unit` / `uom` / `unitCode` / `dimension`; the object door's five pointer refusals (six since 44bf630f1e, with the `valueDomain` target) and the shared-field dimension conflict, each located at its key; Open item 6 first half.
- `packages/objectql/src/validation/unit-code-membership.test.ts`: the three Open item 9 cases, by name `OI9 case 1: refuses a code that is no member, ERR_UNIT_CODE_UNKNOWN / 400 on the code field`, `OI9 case 1: refuses %j, never folded, naming the exact spelling`, `OI9 case 2: refuses the quantity edit beside a retired code, naming the field and never the stored value`, `OI9 case 3: refuses a quantity beside the code %j, ERR_UNIT_CODE_REQUIRED / 400`; Requirement 2 (`refuses a new save with a retired code, ERR_UNIT_CODE_RETIRED / 400`); point 5 and point 6; the once-per-organization read; the delete refusal.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-unit-code-membership.test.ts`: the engine seams (insert, insertMany culling, by-id and predicate update, `validate()`), and the delete refusal under a system context, a user and no context, by id and `multi: true`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/default-permission-sets.unit-of-measure.integration.test.ts` (23, real stack): the delete refusal for an administrator, an owner, a member, a system writer and an automation run, by id and batched; the administrator's effective permissions; an owner edits the administrator's unit (the explicit line keeps the edit the wildcard gave); the write check over a real `sys_unit` (a retired unit, a mis-cased code, another dimension, a blank code, `EA`, and case 2 on a resting row).

Pin sweep (dispatch ①②): the five codes are new, so no pin of them existed; the one pin of the old meaning, the `sys_unit` test that named "the organization admin wildcard grant", now names the explicit line, and the line's substance is asserted in the real-stack cell (effective `allowDelete: false`, create and edit kept, every unit still stored after each refused delete).

Ablations (both committed first, mutated and restored with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the engine suite importing `src/` so no build sits between):

- the `refuseOrganizationUnitDelete(object);` line deleted: anchor 1 to 0, blob `0f0fd66a5919` to `d1a6c4760fff`; `engine-unit-code-membership.test.ts` 3 failed / 15 passed (the system, user and no-context cells; the other-object control stayed green); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- the insert path's `assertUnitCodes` call short-circuited: blob `58ab1cbe7870` to `e037c24b57a0`; 7 failed / 11 passed (every insert refusal and the insertMany cull); restored, blob equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Outside the expected landing zone, each forced by the new key's own gates, no behaviour:** `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts` (`unitConfig: keep`), `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts` (`unitConfig: 'presentation'`), the `metadata-protocol` degenerate-derivation count (84 field keys), `packages/spec/variant-docs.json` (`check:variant-docs` refuses an undeclared union), and the generated `content/docs/references/**` and `docs/audits/**` counts.
- **An organization that holds a unit cannot be deleted.** The organization delete refuses while a tenant row outside its cascade names it (`refuseOrganizationDeleteWhileOwned`, which counts `sys_unit`), and a unit is now never deleted. Before this PR the data door already served no delete, so only an engine-level system delete could clear them; that last path is now closed. Raised as an open question in the hand-back (`sys_unit` outlives its organization, an exemption for the organization delete, or keep), not built here.
- **Open item 9 point 7:** the refusal does not yet name the backfill door, which #35492 adds; whether the metadata save that declares `unitConfig` over stored free text answers a destructive-change finding the way `currency_mode_to_record` does is proposed to ship with that door, since the precedent finding's substance is the remedy it names. Point 7 already ties both cards to one Version Packages release.
- **Not judged, as with currency:** a `record` pointer declared by an object extension is not read by the object door (the door judges one object's own field map).
- **Not in this PR, by fence:** the picker and the unit label (#35490), the aggregate refusal (#35491), the backfill door (#35492), decimal places (#35498), the ADR-0158 amendment (the seat's own PR), and the skills teaching (the `Skills-docs:` line).
- **L1 and L2 (contract review) are owed**; the declaration lines are copied from the claim (7033168211).
